{{Top|leg}}
'''Coruscant Institute for Medical Sciences''' was a medical institute operating on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Around 3641 BBY it co-hosted a lecture by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Tan Kirin]] of the [[Corellian Science Academy]] in conjunction with the [[Republic Medical Journal]].<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Coruscant Institute for Medical Sciences is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the letter [[Elara Dorne]] sends to Trooper if the player pursued the romance option.
